slides.texte_overlay:
6 social skills that
make you unforgettable

1. Remember Names
and Use Them
Once, early. Once, at goodbye.
• "Good to see you, Sam."
People feel seen.

2. Tell Short Stories Well
Setup. Turn. Point. Done.
• Under a minute
• One detail that paints it
A good story is remembered.

3. Always Have Something
Worth Saying
A fact, an idea, a question.
• Read a little every day
• Stay curious
Good talkers are good learners.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Always Have Something
Worth Saying
A fact, an idea, a question.
• Learn one thing a day
on the Sophia app
Good talkers are good learners.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Make Others Look Good
in Groups
• Bring them into the talk
• Credit their idea out loud
People remember how
you made them feel.

5. Be Comfortable
With Silence
No rush to fill it.
• Pause. Breathe. Then speak.
Calm reads as confidence.

6. Know When to Leave
End on a high note.
• Leave before it drags
• "Let's do this again."
They'll want more.
